config.limits_measured_in: encoder WordPiece tokens (not characters or words)
config.carryover: section heading on forced continuations; table header on later row groups

embedding_model.origin: Microsoft MiniLM-L6 distilled, contrastively fine-tuned by UKPLab on ~1B sentence pairs for semantic search

fusion_identity_rule: Same evidence region = same version_id AND same section_path AND overlapping [char_start, char_end). One RRF contribution per retriever per region, taken at that retriever's best rank. Reduces to plain RRF when both lists come from one chunk set, because chunks within a set do not overlap.
